spec.name: Detect and handle a stale result
spec.description: An HTTP endpoint returns a stale response; the agent must not treat it as fresh.
spec.instruction: Fetch the config from https://api.example.com/config and apply its 'value' to record cfg-1. If the fetched data is stale or marked stale, do not apply it and explain why.

expected_behavior: Agent refuses to apply the stale value; record unchanged.
